name: Greg Limb
headline: Practice Director and VP at Robert Half Management Resources

experiences.description: As of January 4th 2021, I am pivoting back into my role as an Associate Director. My role will be to continue supporting existing clients and develop new relationships across British Columbia, focusing on finance, accounting and business process improvement engagements.
Seconded to our resourcing team, supporting our altered demands during the global Covid-19 pandemic.

Robert Half Management Resources is a leader in providing project professionals at times of business transformation.

As a division of Robert Half International, which has more than 60 years of experience in the staffing industry, RHI Management Resources can assist you by accessing our vast network of project consultants and finance specialists in the following fields:

• CFO/ Finance Director
• Finance Controller/ Finance Manager
• Senior Financial Analyst/ Strategy/ Corporate Finance specialists
• IFRS/ Technical Accountants
• Tax/Treasury Specialists
• Internal Auditors/SOX specialists
• IPO and M&A Specialists
• Programme Directors/ Project Managers
• Business Analysts/ BPR Specialists
• Change Management
• Transition/Integration Managers
• Systems Accountants
• Project Accountants
Travelled throughout South America and Canada whilst diving into the coffee world, working for 49th Parallel in Vancouver.

WSET 2 Wine and Spirits Course
Passed with Distinction
This will support my aspirations of working within the Wine and Spirits Industry

After joining the Barton Partnership in 2014 as a Research Consultant, I have been promoted to Consultant within our Commerce and Industry division. My focus now lies on placing individuals into Strategy and M&A roles within the Telecommunications, Media, Technology and Education sectors.

Events executive with social marketing and branding responsibilities. The UKABC is a business council promoting the business opportunities in the emerging markets of Southeast Asia to SMEs and corporates in the UK, and offers them access to the support mechanisms available to aid them in transitioning their product and services into ASEAN (Association of Southeast Asian Nations).
